_comment: Every number in this file is an ASSUMPTION, not data. prep_population.py reads it and the viewer lists it under Method. Change a value, rerun prep_population.py, reload. Data inputs (LODES, ACS, NHTS, Assessor, OSM) are in the other files of this folder.

officeAttendance.note: Weekday share of office-type jobs (sectors in remoteEligible) whose holder is in the building today. Viewer slider default. Downtown LA is well below 2019 attendance; this is a stated assumption, not a measurement.

otherAttendance.note: Weekday presence for jobs that cannot be done remotely (retail, food, hotel, health, construction...): sick days, vacation, part-time days.

remoteEligible.note: LODES NAICS sectors treated as office work that the attendance slider applies to: information, finance, real estate, professional, management, administrative, public administration.

weekendWorkShare.note: Share of a sector's jobs also worked on a typical weekend day.

workHours.note: Time at work including lunch, mean and SD in hours. 'shift' applies to sectors outside remoteEligible.

lunchOutShare.note: Share of present office workers who leave their building for lunch; the rest eat in the building. Lunch start and dwell come from NHTS work-to-meal trips.

afterWorkOutShare.note: Share of present workers who stop at a restaurant or bar on site before commuting home.

floorHeight.note: Metres per storey, used to stack people on floors inside the LiDAR building volumes.

jobWeightByUse.note: Relative floor-area weight when a Census block's jobs are split among its buildings.

sectorUseAffinity.note: Multiplies the weight of a building use for jobs of a sector, so restaurant jobs land in retail space and county jobs in government buildings.

sqftPerHotelRoom.note: Gross building area per hotel room when the room count is not known.

ownGarageMinArea.note: Buildings over this modeled floor area (m2) are assumed to have their own garage: drivers appear at the building door.

modeByDistance.note: Short commutes are mostly walked. Beyond 3 km the modes follow ACS B08601 (workers whose workplace is in the City of Los Angeles). Downtown's real transit share is likely higher than the city average; there is no keyless tract-level workplace table (CTPP) to check it.

residentOutings.note: Non-work outings per resident per day; share that stay on site (food, shops). Timing from NHTS home-based trips.

visitors.note: Daily visitors who are not workers, residents or hotel guests. Order-of-magnitude placeholders: replace with published counts when available. 'meals' profile = NHTS start times of trips to buy meals.

angelsFlightShare.note: Share of Grand Central Market visitors who then ride Angels Flight up to Bunker Hill (California Plaza / MOCA) before leaving.

value.name: Concert at Walt Disney Concert Hall

event.note: Optional evening event just north of the site (toggle in the viewer). Seat count as published by the venue; occupancy and the share whose route (garage or Metro) crosses the site are assumptions.

walkSpeed.note: Walking speed, mean and SD (m/s). Vertical travel inside buildings (elevator) counts at 2.5 m/s plus 40 s waiting.
